<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$page = get_page_by_path('uvod');
$id = $page ? $page->ID : wp_insert_post(array('post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Úvod', 'post_name' => 'uvod'), true);
if (is_wp_error($id)) { throw new RuntimeException($id->get_error_message()); }
update_post_meta($id, '_wp_page_template', 'bez-nadpisu');
update_option('page_on_front', $id);
update_option('show_on_front', 'page');
